status: algorithm frozen after family-disjoint invariance audit and before merged full-collection outcome inspection; not preregistered
scientific_objective: Upgrade the periodic first-sphere adapter from deterministic serialization in a supplied P1 setting to a canonical local coordination-state identity invariant to atom order, global origin, periodic-image representative, quotient-orbit numbering, proper Cartesian rotation, and tested equivalent unimodular cell-basis changes.

claimed_if_full_run_integrity_passes: Canonical metric identity for a periodic local CN2-6 coordination state under the full orthogonal frame group O(3).
Canonical stereochemical identity under right-handed Cartesian frames and proper rotations SO(3).
Retention of the equivalence partition identifying translated multiedges to the same periodic donor orbit.
A deterministic multiset identity for the collection of emitted local states in one MOF entry.
not_claimed: Canonical identity of a complete MOF framework, net, linker, pore, guest population, disorder model, or crystallographic species.
Stereochemical identity under an improper Cartesian reflection; the parity-free metric identity remains invariant in that case.
Identity across different metal-donor bond assignments or different chemical-domain rules.
Universal predictive superiority over graph neural networks or Cartesian neural networks.

canonical_quotient.cluster_rule: same-element symmetry-expanded images are joined when their minimum-image Cartesian separation is no greater than 0.002 A
canonical_quotient.representative_rule: arithmetic mean in a unique compact local lift of the fractional three-torus, followed by wrapping
canonical_quotient.reason: the legacy first-encountered representative is atom-order dependent when nominally identical symmetry-expanded images differ by CIF rounding
canonical_quotient.edge_witness: raw quotient-orbit and integer translation labels remain in the audit record, but their literal integers are not cross-basis identity fields

canonical_local_identity.metric_layer: lexicographically minimal donor-labelled Gram matrix over all donor permutations, including a restricted-growth encoding of the periodic donor-orbit equivalence partition
canonical_local_identity.stereo_layer: metric layer plus donor-labelled signed triple products, canonicalized over the same permutations
canonical_local_identity.hash: SHA-256 of the complete canonical JSON payload

chemical_gates.source: unchanged from frozen periodic v2 pipeline
